items.title: Chuck Findley interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 6, 2023
items.q: Bangledesh you know with George Harrison, my goodness you know, how fantastic that was, and the tour we did.

ctx.x: What kind of thing, this could be a pro or a con, but would you go home and bother to bring up what your day was like? What kind of sessions?

Occasionally. You know I actually, if I did I told my wife and she is my dictionary and my encyclopedia. She tells me what I did and what I didn’t do ‘cause I did so many things, you know, I mean the ones that really stuck out of course, like doing the “Dingo” album with Michel Legrand or Al Jarreau things I did, or there was so many things. Bangledesh you know with George Harrison, my goodness you know, how fantastic that was, and the tour we did. Peter Herbolzheimer in Germany, you know things I did there.…
Yeah. Bobby said that my wife could tell by the look on my face how my day went in the studios when I got home.
